project_decisions: CompanyOS validation derives the pilot claim audit surface from the union of assurance_claim_bindings and assurance_pilot_claim_history task/generation keys.
Every union member requires both signed counterparts with exact task, generation, initiative, artifact set, fencing-token digest, and creation timestamp values.
Missing counterparts, generation/value differences, and either invalid domain-specific signature use the existing bound-pilot inconsistency error.
Never-bound and nonpilot tasks remain outside pilot reconciliation because neither signed pilot claim table contains a key for them.
